title: Olive Town
subtitle: A Metabolic Community System Beneath the Viaduct
summary: An adaptable urban sanctuary that combines modular architecture, digital services and an inclusive local economy for wanderers and people experiencing homelessness.
body: Olive Town reimagines the overlooked space beneath a viaduct as an adaptable community for wanderers and people experiencing homelessness. Inspired by Kisho Kurokawa’s Metabolism movement, modular architecture works with a digital service ecosystem to provide safe shelter, work opportunities, healthcare, performance spaces and community support. A mobile application connects residents to these services, while Olive Coin and a tiered certification model reward participation without relying on conventional financial structures. By bringing spatial design, technology and social care into one system, the project proposes a more dignified and autonomous model of urban belonging.
